voice: Argo CD says the GPU release is healthy.
That green status belongs to the version already running.
AICR Operator requests the new revision and Argo CD takes over the sync.
A dependent release stays in the queue while the status still describes the previous one.
The Operator checks the chart digest and the values Argo CD compared.
It also needs a fresh sync or reconcile, healthy resources, and a status clear of sync or comparison errors.
Now the signal belongs to this rollout step.
With the new revision ready, the Operator advances to the dependent release.
When deployment validation is enabled, AICR checks the finished stack and can attach evidence to the rollout plan.
